Diagnosis: The runtime error explicitly rejects mixing freeze_orientation with other orientation constraints in one stage: the previous list had two axis_align terms and one freeze_orientation term. The smallest repair is to remove the freeze_orientation term while keeping the required cube-to-cube face alignment axis_align constraints.
Reasoning: This remains a single conjunctive controller stage. The reach_point term drives the grasped cube_3 origin to the placement target at cube_2 origin plus world +z 0.05 m with 0.01 m tolerance, which also enforces the required lateral alignment within that 3D tolerance; manipulator_low_effort represents the supported requirement to avoid excessive impact during touchdown. The two axis_align terms keep cube_3 face axes bipolar with cube_2 axes, allowing sign ambiguity for symmetric cubes. The object_grasped term with gripper_closed condition requires cube_3 to remain held by the closed panda_fingertip gripper. To satisfy the error, freeze_orientation was removed because it cannot be combined with axis_align in the same stage; the no-intentional-rotation requirement is only indirectly represented by maintaining cube_3/cube_2 axis alignment. The explicit panda_fingertip world -z travel of 0.10 m is not separately encoded because only one position op is allowed and the final placement target is the success-critical position constraint. Fixed cube_3-to-gripper transform, stable finger effort/contact feedback, contact permission/avoidance, cube_2 remaining stacked on cube_1, cube_1/cube_2 pose stability, and feedback monitoring are not directly expressible with the available operators for non-gripped objects or sensors.
